result.summary: The page is largely intact, but the promotional banner has poor text contrast: white headline/subtext on a light mint-green background is washed out and hard to read. No critical blockers found; excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff per instructions.

issues.description: Promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white/very light on a pale mint-green background, resulting in low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or switch the headline/subtitle to a darker green/neutral color to meet WCAG contrast guidance while keeping the 'Order now' button styling consistent.
